# nbzinbreg

Negative binomial (NB) and zero-inflated negative binomial (ZINB)
regression in R, with the estimation written from scratch: iteratively
reweighted least squares (IRLS) and Newton-Raphson for NB, and the EM
algorithm with IRLS steps for ZINB. No general-purpose optimizer is
used. NB results are validated against
[`MASS::glm.nb()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/MASS/man/glm.nb.html), and ZINB
results against
[`pscl::zeroinfl()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/pscl/man/zeroinfl.html).

## Status

Negative binomial and zero-inflated negative binomial regression are
implemented and validated, with all required methods and the extras
(confidence intervals, model tests, bootstrap and diagnostics), and
benchmarked against `glm.nb()` and `zeroinfl()`, with a simulation study
of
[`zinbreg()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/zinbreg.md)
and an analysis of the NMES1988 data. The report is drafted; the
author’s AI-use statement and final review come next.

| Part | Status |
|----|----|
| Package skeleton (installs, documented, CI) | ✅ Done |
| [`nbreg()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/nbreg.md): negative binomial regression | ✅ Done |
| [`zinbreg()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/zinbreg.md): zero-inflated NB regression | ✅ Done |
| Methods (`print`, `summary`, `predict`, …) | ✅ Done |
| Extras (confidence intervals, model tests, diagnostics) | ✅ Done |
| Benchmarks against `glm.nb()` and `zeroinfl()` | ✅ Done |
| Simulation study | ✅ Done |
| NMES1988 data analysis | ✅ Done |
| Report and website | 🚧 Awaiting the author’s AI-use statement and review |

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("jaxsonbugg/nbzinbreg")
```

## Usage

### Negative binomial regression

``` r

library(nbzinbreg)
data("bioChemists", package = "pscl")

fit_nb <- nbreg(art ~ fem + mar + kid5 + phd + ment, data = bioChemists)
summary(fit_nb)
#> 
#> Call:
#> nbreg(formula = art ~ fem + mar + kid5 + phd + ment, data = bioChemists)
#> 
#> Pearson residuals:
#>     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
#> -1.2677 -0.8754 -0.2613  0.4983  6.6573 
#> 
#> Coefficients:
#>              Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
#> (Intercept)  0.256144   0.137348   1.865 0.062191 .  
#> femWomen    -0.216418   0.072636  -2.979 0.002887 ** 
#> marMarried   0.150489   0.082097   1.833 0.066791 .  
#> kid5        -0.176415   0.052813  -3.340 0.000837 ***
#> phd          0.015271   0.035873   0.426 0.670326    
#> ment         0.029082   0.003214   9.048  < 2e-16 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
#> 
#> Theta: 2.264 (SE 0.2712)
#> Log-likelihood: -1560.96 on 7 df
#> AIC: 3135.92;  BIC: 3169.65
#> Observations: 915;  residual df: 909
#> Outer passes: 4;  converged: yes
```

### Zero-inflated negative binomial regression

``` r

library(nbzinbreg)
data("bioChemists", package = "pscl")

# Same covariates in both parts; use y ~ x | z to choose the zero-part
# covariates separately.
fit_zinb <- zinbreg(art ~ fem + mar + kid5 + phd + ment, data = bioChemists)
summary(fit_zinb)
#> 
#> Call:
#> zinbreg(formula = art ~ fem + mar + kid5 + phd + ment, data = bioChemists)
#> 
#> Pearson residuals:
#>     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
#> -1.2942 -0.7601 -0.2909  0.4448  6.4155 
#> 
#> Count model coefficients (negative binomial with log link):
#>               Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
#> (Intercept)  0.4167473  0.1435962   2.902  0.00371 ** 
#> femWomen    -0.1955061  0.0755925  -2.586  0.00970 ** 
#> marMarried   0.0975830  0.0844519   1.155  0.24789    
#> kid5        -0.1517319  0.0542061  -2.799  0.00512 ** 
#> phd         -0.0006999  0.0362696  -0.019  0.98460    
#> ment         0.0247861  0.0034924   7.097 1.27e-12 ***
#> Log(theta)   0.9763605  0.1354682   7.207 5.71e-13 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
#> 
#> Zero-inflation model coefficients (binomial with logit link):
#>             Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)   
#> (Intercept)  -0.1917     1.3228  -0.145  0.88475   
#> femWomen      0.6359     0.8489   0.749  0.45378   
#> marMarried   -1.4994     0.9386  -1.597  0.11017   
#> kid5          0.6284     0.4428   1.419  0.15582   
#> phd          -0.0377     0.3080  -0.122  0.90257   
#> ment         -0.8823     0.3162  -2.790  0.00527 **
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
#> 
#> Theta: 2.655 (SE 0.3596)
#> Log-likelihood: -1549.99 on 13 df
#> AIC: 3125.98;  BIC: 3188.63
#> Observations: 915;  residual df: 902
#> EM iterations: 123;  converged: yes
#> Gradient check: Newton decrement 8.47e-09 (grad_tol 1e-08)
#> Starting values: count part from negative binomial fit; zero part from logistic fit of I(y == 0)
```

### Inference and diagnostics

``` r

# Profile-likelihood interval for theta, Wald intervals for the coefficients
confint(fit_nb)
#>                2.5 %   97.5 %
#> (Intercept) -0.01305  0.52534
#> femWomen    -0.35878 -0.07405
#> marMarried  -0.01042  0.31140
#> kid5        -0.27993 -0.07290
#> phd         -0.05504  0.08558
#> ment         0.02278  0.03538
#> theta        1.80734  2.89853

# Is there overdispersion? (Poisson against NB)
overdispersion_test(fit_nb)
#> 
#>  Likelihood-ratio test for overdispersion (Poisson against negative
#>  binomial; boundary-corrected p-value)
#> 
#> data:  art ~ fem + mar + kid5 + phd + ment
#> LR = 180.2, p-value < 2.2e-16
#> alternative hypothesis: true theta is less than Inf
#> sample estimates:
#>    theta 
#> 2.264388

# Observed against expected frequencies of the first few counts
head(expected_counts(fit_zinb), 4)
#>   count observed expected
#> 1     0      275 285.4333
#> 2     1      246 233.9321
#> 3     2      178 165.3441
#> 4     3       84 101.2073
```

Model comparison with [`anova()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/anova.html)
and
[`vuong_test()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/vuong_test.md)
(including a bootstrap likelihood-ratio test of NB against ZINB),
bootstrap standard errors
([`boot_se()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/boot_se.md)),
[`simulate()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/simulate.html),
[`rootogram()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/rootogram.md),
and [`tidy()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/tidy.html) /
[`glance()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/glance.html) are also
available; see the function reference.

## Check results

`R CMD check`: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 notes on all CI platforms (macOS,
Windows and Ubuntu; R release, devel and the previous release). A local
Windows run may show one NOTE, “unable to verify current time”, which
comes from the machine’s clock check, not from the package.

# Package index

## Fitting models

- [`nbreg()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/nbreg.md)
  : Negative binomial regression by IRLS and Newton-Raphson
- [`zinbreg()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/zinbreg.md)
  : Zero-inflated negative binomial regression by EM with IRLS M-steps

## Control settings

- [`nbreg_control()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/nbreg_control.md)
  : Control settings for nbreg()
- [`zinbreg_control()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/zinbreg_control.md)
  : Control settings for zinbreg()

## Inference

Confidence intervals, likelihood-ratio tests of nested models, the
overdispersion test, and the comparison of a zero-inflated fit with a
negative binomial fit.

- [`confint(`*`<nbreg>`*`)`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/confint-nbzinbreg.md)
  [`print(`*`<nbzinbreg_confint>`*`)`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/confint-nbzinbreg.md)
  [`confint(`*`<zinbreg>`*`)`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/confint-nbzinbreg.md)
  : Confidence intervals for nbreg and zinbreg fits
- [`anova(`*`<nbreg>`*`)`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/anova-nbzinbreg.md)
  [`anova(`*`<zinbreg>`*`)`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/anova-nbzinbreg.md)
  [`print(`*`<nbzinbreg_anova>`*`)`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/anova-nbzinbreg.md)
  : Likelihood-ratio tests for nested nbreg or zinbreg fits
- [`overdispersion_test()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/overdispersion_test.md)
  : Test for overdispersion: Poisson against negative binomial
- [`vuong_test()`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/vuong_test.md)
  [`print(`*`<nbzinbreg_vuong>`*`)`](https://jaxsonbugg.github.io/nbzinbreg/reference/vuong_test.md)
  : Compare a zinbreg fit with an nbreg fit

## Simulation and bootstrap
